positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Norfolk City County, Virginia, United States

positions.title: Project IT Lead / Systems Analyst Principal
positions.description: I am the Project IT Lead for the Cultural Knowledge Consortium.  www.culturalknowledge.org

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description: Provide management support for the company technical team.  Direct technical support of on-site programs.  Ensure long-term technical vision of the company is aligned with corporate strategic plan.  Coordinate proposals for new projects.  Conduct technical team evaluations and reviews.  Prioritize technical team tasking.  Coordinate and provide hands-on support for on-site personnel.  Prioritize and review major program changes.  Interview and hire new technical personnel.  Provide computer systems and database engineering and technical services.  Provide computer and information technology assessments.  Develop data systems and provide system maintenance and technical support.  Assist customers in defining and implementing project requirements. Provide automated tool set assistance for process analysis and redesign tasks.  Languages include:  VB, VBA, C++, Java, DOS, UNIX, and DXL.  Applications include:  MS Office, MS Project, DOORS, CodeWarrior, Crystal Report Writer, .NET, XML.

positions.title: Information Systems Specialist
positions.description: Provide technical support and training for Novell LAN users.  Perform software, hardware, and network troubleshooting and maintenance.  Perform database management functions.  Main contact for System 36 and AS/400 problems.  Install and maintain voice and data lines for conference groups.  Monitor telephone switch, voice mail, and all computer interfaces.  Applications include:  WordPerfect, Lotus, Harvard Graphics, Dbase, FoxPro, PAR Golf system, HIS Front Office system, Crystal Report Writer, Microsoft Office Professional, UNIX, Micros POS system, Meeting Matrix, and Delphi Sales/Catering system.
